The ground truth requires dc2 to be built from the substitution, vacancy, AND H interstitial (all three defects), making dc ≠ dc2. The generated spec instead constructs dc2 identically to dc (substitution + vacancy only), which means defect_complex_equality would incorrectly return True and defect_complex_inequality would return False. The ground truth intent is that these two complexes differ (one has H interstitial, one doesn't), so equality should be False and inequality should be True. This is a critical logical error that alters the core behavior of the function for at least two of the nine required properties, and also affects how supercell_structure_with_dummy_formula is computed (using a dummy 'X' species workaround instead of properly inserting H into dc2's structure).
